hazard_interface.precedence: Already admitted movement, attack, cast and compulsory displacement are commitments. A new hazard cannot cancel, refund, rotate, teleport or shorten them. A later voluntary command may sacrifice a previously affordable escape and is attributed to that command.
hazard_interface.operation: General inherited game admission promises at least one temporally reachable escape accounting for recovery, latency, walls, already committed hazards and compulsory motion; it never rewrites old commitments. candidates.title: Failed casts make an origin-sensitive exit obligation
candidates.relational_unit: Three actual cast interruptions fund one shared spatial jurisdiction: starting an eligible cast inside records a duty to cross outward before that cast closes. Moving into the region after starting outside does not create that duty; region expiry does not erase an existing duty.
candidates.abstraction_level: policy/rule; composed into encounter workflow through public cast events and authored movement

rules.mark_funding: A living equipped hero has three run-owned residue credits, capacity three. An admitted eligible ArcBolt costs five mana whether it completes or fails. A genuine pre-completion interruption (enemy interruption or admitted player CANCEL after the 0.5-second windup) with a residue credit and no active region consumes one credit and records (cast ID, center position, event ID). One mark per cast. Losing HP without interrupting, a rejected cast or cancelling before admission creates no mark. No XP/reward from failed casts.
rules.mark_identity_geometry: Marks are phase-owned and ordered by interruption event ID. Three distinct cast IDs consume all three marks. If triangle area is at least 0.5 square units they create one closed triangle for eight seconds; if degenerate/collinear they create no region, retain no marks and refund no credits. Boundary is inside. Feedback previews the three named preparation points and rejects neither real failure nor its cost.
rules.region_capacity: At most one region. Interruptions while it is active do not spend residue credits or create another region. On phase exit, remove unused marks and the region; spent credits remain spent. Equipment removal occurs only at paused selection and does not discharge a cast obligation.
rules.cast_origin: At admission freeze eligible spell's cast ID, owner, origin membership and region ID. ArcBolt and the disclosed enemy MireBolt have a 0.5-second immobile windup and 1.5-second movable recovery/commitment; their effect resolves at the two-second close. Starting outside grants ordinary completion even if the caster enters later. Starting inside requires an actual continuous movement crossing from inside/boundary to strictly outside after admission and at or before close. A mere command or teleport to a node is not a crossing. A cast carrying an origin duty owns an immutable copy of its admission triangle's three coordinates and boundary convention. OUTSIDE-crossing tests this snapshot until cast closure, even after the live region is deleted; no lookup into a retired region or new region with the same visual name.
rules.cast_completion: Movement and crossing events resolve before the same-boundary close verdict. If the recorded origin obligation has been satisfied and caster survives without cast interruption, effect resolves once; otherwise it fizzles once. The effect is not applied early. Current region membership alone is never the verdict.
rules.interruption: An interrupted cast closes without its effect and can fund exactly one eligible mark. A cast ID closed by interruption cannot later complete, cross successfully or fund another mark. Ordinary melee and movement do not require an exit.
rules.expiry: Remove the region before admitting new casts at its exact eight-second boundary. Existing cast obligations remain owned by their cast until its original two-second close, interruption or caster death; expiry never grants automatic completion.
rules.death_owner_exit: Resolve damage/hazards and caster death before a close payoff. Death closes the cast without effect or refund. Boss phase exit removes region/unused marks but preserves an already admitted living hero cast until close; a removed enemy owner cancels its cast without effect. Stage handover waits for a live admitted hero cast to close; no escape via menu.
rules.resource: Residue credits initialize once per run at three only when the optional tool is selected at run setup; otherwise zero until acquired. A later acquired tool gives no automatic free credits. An explicit residue bundle offers +3 capped at three at paused acquisition and replaces another offer; mana obeys inherited finite ordinary economy. Carry remaining credits across all stages; no phase refill.
rules.route_cursor_owner: Policy owns PREP_LOOP cursor with states P1_WAIT_MARK→P2_WAIT_MARK→P3_WAIT_MARK→H_WAIT_CAST→EXIT_WAIT→M→H_WAIT_CAST. Each P wait is tied to the actual admitted preparation cast ID at that point; only that cast's one successful interruption-mark event advances it. STOP preserves cursor. CANCEL changes only the named cast; it cannot advance by intention. Third mark transaction turns PREPARATION false and sets H_WAIT_CAST if region formed; degenerate transaction selects ordinary PERIMETER instead. H cast admission arms the EXIT_WAIT latch; an actual outward crossing of that same cast advances to M. EXIT is a separate H→X route, so its replacement of PREP_LOOP does not restart P1. At M arrival, next MOVE(PREP_LOOP) resumes M→H. An interrupted H cast clears its gate and resumes M→H without an invented crossing; it still fails normally.
rules.ordinary_route: PERIMETER is explicitly the fixed loop M(4,4)→(6,4)→(6,6)→(4,6)→M. At M, a fixed declared ordinary boss target at (4.5,4) is in the authored melee window. Other actual positions can make that attack reject; no useful target is selected automatically. With no region/preparation this route still visits M.

rules.segments: For displacement length L, traverse first direction by f1*L then second by f2*L, in listed order. The first blocking collision truncates the ENTIRE displacement at that point: no leftover movement on segment2, sliding, refund or extra distance. If first completes unobstructed, second begins there and can truncate. Apply normal collision sweep; this ordered operation is not directional influence selected after the hit.

candidates.relational_unit: The gate acts on the current public source clause, while a scout carries one publicly acquired older clause as a committed finite route. Editing changes world truth immediately and changes the scout's next plan only at its next inspection.

rules.map: One physical placard P, marked tiles EAST and NORTH, ward gate WEST and two fixed route tables are authored. The flyer can bypass ordinary walls but cannot bypass the gate's disclosed ward. Hero and scout crossing the current source tile have identical trigger rights.
rules.law: Initial law version v0 says outside→inside crossing of EAST opens WEST for 1.5 seconds. AMEND(NORTH) is an idle-only placard interaction within its named radius: 0.4-second admitted operation, consume one amendment at admission, change source and increment version at completion. Cost remains after interruption; failed operation makes no change. One amendment allowed per phase; no free reversal. Current law is public continuously.
rules.source_crossing: Trigger only a genuine outside→inside center crossing of the current source tile, not standing, a requested path, exiting the tile or an old acquired clause. Refresh one gate interval to max(current close, crossing time+1.5), no stacked tokens. Process by stable event ID.
rules.gate: WEST passage admission requires time < gate_close AND scout commitment_time < commitment_deadline. One admitted passage owns movement for its 0.5-second physical traversal. At commitment deadline, a scout not already in an admitted passage closes its route and starts its authored return; no new WEST admission occurs even if a third actor opens it on that boundary. If passage was admitted earlier, state becomes FINISHING_PASSAGE_RETURN_DUE: finish it without cancellation/teleport, then start RETURN from its actual exit. Gate closure never crushes/ejects an admitted actor.
rules.scout_inspection: At P, READ lasts 0.5 seconds. At its completion copy current law/version and select exactly the table for that source: EAST→WEST→RETURN or NORTH→WEST→RETURN. Show source, read version and finite route. Commit for at most six seconds; no replan on a law edit.
rules.route_commit: Scout follows its acquired finite route with one movement owner. Blocked WEST waits while commitment_time < deadline. At deadline close source/gate intentions once; RETURN is immediately active unless an earlier admitted passage must finish. Returning never replans to a new source. The scout can be damaged/killed normally in either state.
rules.public_edit_window: For the paper fixture READ completes at t0; source crossing is scheduled t0+2 and WEST arrival t0+2.5 if geometry permits. Placard is reachable by the hero at t0+0.6 and amendment can complete at t0+1.0. These are authored fixture assumptions. An obstructed source segment may make arrival later; the public countdown updates physical progress without changing the acquired route.
rules.combat: Scout retains one disclosed ordinary attack opportunity per commitment at its fixed waypoint. Blocking its gate route does not damage or defeat it automatically; it can be killed normally, and a boss retains ordinary recovery/HP defeat. No unlimited attack/XP generation from repeated failed routes.
rules.resource_owner_exit: Amendments run-owned, capacity two, start two with optional setup tool; optional +1 cache refill capped at two; no automatic phase refill. Phase owns law/gate/scout commitments and initializes EAST once on entry. Owner exit cancels unfinished reads/routes and closes the removed gate; spent amendments persist. Stage transition waits for living hero's admitted amendment recovery to end.
rules.pause: Paused acquisition freezes read/edit/route/gate clocks; changes in command source do not reset a read version, grant an inspection or discharge a queued crossing.
rules.return_geometry: Each source route stores its visited waypoint prefix and current segment cursor. A return from P is STOP/arrival; from a partially traversed P→E or P→N segment follows that same segment backward to P; from E/N→WEST entrance reverses the partial current segment then the visited E/N→P prefix; from WEST exit uses the authored EXIT→P return segment. These are a finite table plus actual segment progress, not new geometry search. A changed wall/closed ward can block a return: STOP with RETURN_BLOCKED and retry only its current segment on public clearance. Never skip to P or read remotely. READ can start only after real P arrival and no passage owns movement. Two seconds is the clear-path WEST-exit fixture estimate, not a universal or enforced return duration.

authored_encounter_trace: Assume READ completes at t0 with EAST/v0; scout route shows EAST crossing at +2, WEST arrival +2.5 and commitment limit +6.
Hero's fixed ACCESS reaches P at +0.6; AMEND completes at +1, spending a charge and setting NORTH/v1. Scout publicly retains EAST/v0.

At +2 scout crosses EAST: no current-law trigger. At +2.5 WEST is closed and passage rejects. Scout waits without changing source until +6, then returns in its fixed two-second route and reads NORTH/v1.
Counterbranch: hero or another enemy crosses NORTH at +2.1; WEST opens until +3.6, so the scout's still-stale route can pass at +2.5. Staleness is not immunity to current world events.
Without amendment EAST opens WEST normally. At exact same boundary completed edit precedes tile crossing and READ: both evaluate the new law. These are authored branches, not observed AI behavior.

RP06 exact deadline: at +6, a third actor crosses NORTH and opens WEST. The stale scout's commitment expires before new gate passage admission, so it starts RETURN and cannot also cross. If WEST passage was already admitted at +5.9, it finishes at +6.4, then RETURN starts from exit; there is one movement owner.

RP07 obstructed return: a wall blocks the source segment before WEST. On deadline reverse the actual visited prefix; if a new wall also blocks that reverse path, remain RETURN_BLOCKED with no READ. Only actual later P arrival permits a new read/version. The fixture's two-second return is not remote reinspection.

RP08 conditional USE: DENY amendment completes at +1; hero reaches a disclosed optional cache at P at +1.1, pauses, selects USE without resetting any clock/state, then resumes and crosses NORTH at +2.1. The stale scout can use the gate. Without that cache/window, auto's second complete alternative is preserve EAST from setup; no unconditional NORTH-use claim.

RP01 warning witness: from placard P, actual ESCAPE runs P→safe south pad in 0.6 seconds with assumed0.1 latency before a +1 lethal activation, with no admitted immobile edit. During a committed edit recovery the same issuer must account for0.4 seconds and reject/delay a warning that the fixed route cannot afford.
